milestone: Generalized Intent / Cross-reference / Fast Section Candidate
design_goal: Improve generalization without hardcoding the final QA prompts. Routing decisions are based on source structure and intent families.

compiler_switch_disambiguation.behavior: Compiler/toolchain switch/option/flag wording is kept separate from the C language switch-statement family.
compiler_switch_disambiguation.source_grounding: Compiler-option rule candidates are derived from source child sections that explicitly mention compiler command-line options/flags, then mapped to their parent Rule requirements.

rationale_cross_reference_follow.behavior: If an exact Rule/Directive rationale explicitly defers its explanation to a Section identifier, that exact cited Section is appended and used for the why/rationale answer.

structured_section_title_fastpath.behavior: Short near-exact document-section title queries are matched against indexed Section metadata before vector/reranker retrieval.

technical_english_noun_phrase_detection.behavior: Clearly English technical/document noun phrases no longer trigger the multilingual LLM query adapter merely because they lack an English function word.
